title: Certificate of Analysis
description: A machine-readable representation of a certificate of analysis for a single production lot of a botanical or dietary supplement product. Describes what a COA states; it does not assert that any stated result is correct.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the document was written against.

document.description: Identity and provenance of the certificate itself, as distinct from the product it describes.

document_id.description: Identifier for this certificate, unique within the issuing laboratory.

revision.description: Revision number. A reissued certificate increments this.

supersedes.description: document_id of the certificate this one replaces, if any.

authorized_by.description: Name and title of the person who released the certificate.

product.description: The material tested. A certificate covers exactly one lot.

lot_identifier.description: The lot or batch code printed on the product. Without this the certificate cannot be matched to physical product, which is the single most common defect in published COAs.

form.description: Physical form of the tested material.

botanical_name.description: Binomial name where the product is a botanical.

laboratory.description: The testing laboratory. An unnamed laboratory makes a certificate unverifiable.

accreditation.description: Accreditation held by the laboratory, e.g. ISO/IEC 17025:2017.

independent.description: True when the laboratory is not owned by or affiliated with the manufacturer. Omit rather than guess.

results.description: One entry per analyte measured. An empty array is not a certificate.

source.description: Where this record was transcribed from.

date.description: Calendar date, ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD. Relative dates are not representable by design.

identifier.description: Registry identifier, e.g. an FDA establishment number.

analyte.description: Substance measured, e.g. 'Lead', 'Mitragynine', 'Total aerobic microbial count'.

panel.description: Which test panel this result belongs to.

method.description: Analytical method, e.g. 'ICP-MS', 'HPLC-UV', 'USP <2021>'. A result without a method cannot be compared to another laboratory's result.

value.description: Numeric result. Omit when the result is non-numeric or below the limit of quantitation; use value_qualifier instead.

value_qualifier.description: Used when a numeric value is not the correct representation.

specification.description: The acceptance criterion this result was judged against.

source.description: Where the criterion comes from, e.g. 'USP', 'AHPA', 'internal'.

outcome.description: The laboratory's stated judgement. Validated against specification and value by the consistency rules, which is where most real defects surface.

unit.description: Unit of measure. ppm and mg/kg are equivalent; ppb is one thousandth of ppm, and confusing the two is a 1000x error that appears in real certificates.
